layout_and_spacing.grid_strategy: Asymmetric layouts, overlap elements to break rigid grids, generous negative space.

motion_and_interactions.scroll_reveal: Staggered fade-up with slight rotation using framer-motion.
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Scale up slightly, shadow deepens, border color shifts to primary.
motion_and_interactions.marquee: Fast-moving, text-8xl outline text in background, mix of filled and outlined typography.
motion_and_interactions.parallax: Images in bento boxes have slow scale effect on scroll.

navigation.classes: fixed top-6 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/40 rounded-full px-8 py-4 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.05)] z-50 flex items-center justify-between w-[95%] max-w-5xl

hero.layout: Massive text taking up 70% of viewport, overlapping a vibrant image or video loop with a pill-shaped CTA floating near the bottom.

cards.classes: bg-white rounded-3xl p-8 border-2 border-transparent hover:border-[#0033FF] transition-colors duration-300 shadow-sm hover:shadow-xl

buttons.primary: bg-[#0033FF] text-[#CCFF00] rounded-full px-8 py-4 font-bold uppercase tracking-wide hover:bg-[#0022CC] transition-all
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-[#0A0A0A] border-2 border-[#0A0A0A] rounded-full px-8 py-4 font-bold uppercase tracking-wide hover:bg-[#0A0A0A] hover:text-white transition-all

sections.name: Hero
sections.design_notes: Massive H1 'SAFE RIDE' in Clash Display. A fast marquee behind the text reading 'DRIVING SCHOOL ZÜRICH & SCHWYZ'. Vibrant Cobalt blue primary CTA.

sections.name: Über mich (Nadine Stäubli)
sections.design_notes: Asymmetric layout. Large portrait image (rounded-3xl) offset with a big typography block 'Your Instructor'. Vibrant pink or lime accent blob behind the image.

sections.name: Services / Angebote
sections.design_notes: Bento grid of 6 cards. Background is a soft cream #F4F5F0. Cards are white with large colorful icons and bold titles.

sections.name: Fahrzeugflotte
sections.design_notes: Horizontal scrolling section or large staggered cards. High-contrast imagery of Audi S3, Opel OPC, Range Rover Sport. Overlay with thick typography.

sections.name: Preise
sections.design_notes: Split layout: ZH/SZ vs GR. Use big bold price numbers (e.g., 'CHF 90'). High contrast boxes (one blue with lime text, one white with dark text).

sections.name: Bildergalerie
sections.design_notes: Masonry grid with hover-to-reveal color or hover-to-zoom (parallax) effect.

sections.name: Bewertungen
sections.design_notes: Marquee slider with review cards. Cards have a vibrant top border and big quote marks.

sections.name: Kontaktformular
sections.design_notes: Solid Cobalt Blue background section. White massive typography. The form uses thick bottom borders for inputs (no full box), placeholder text in neon lime.

sections.name: Admin CMS
sections.design_notes: Functional but styled. Font family (Outfit). Restrained use of Cobalt Blue for primary actions. Lots of white space, dense tables. Apply data-testid to interactive elements.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use 'Clash Display' for all massive headings and 'Outfit' for body text. Apply framer-motion for scroll reveals and continuous marquees. Implement the floating pill nav. Ensure the contrast between #0033FF (Cobalt) and #CCFF00 (Lime) is used for high-impact CTAs. Ditch all previous dark-theme artifacts. Apply data-testid to all interactive elements. Generate .js and .jsx files, not .tsx. Implement a responsive DE/EN switcher in the nav.
